source.note: the rule blocks listed in copied_verbatim are byte-for-byte the JSON values of config_f1.json (prereg section 2: 'Same rule as E22-F1 ... reused through E22-F1's frozen code, unchanged'); idm.correlation is config_f1.json idm.correlation restricted to the 11 modelled exposures

capital_usd.source: prereg section 2: 'positions for a 20% annual volatility target on $25,000 of notional capital (fixed, no compounding)'; section 5: 'K = $25,000'; equals config_f1.json capital_usd

reg_t_multiplier.source: reports/stage_e24_prereg_F2.md section 4 step 2 (filled by the lead 2026-10-18): 2 x capital; reports/stage_e24_briefs/facts/alpaca_facts.md A7 '2x overnight'

leverage_cap_usd.source: prereg section 4 step 2: 'B = $50,000: the overnight (Reg T) buying power of a margin account whose equity is the fixed capital, 2 x $25,000'; multiplier from alpaca_facts.md A7 '2x overnight'

fractional_increment_shares.source: prereg section 4 step 4 (filled by the lead 2026-10-18): 0.001 share, declared; Alpaca accepts up to 9 decimals (alpaca_facts.md A5)

long_rounding.value: half away from zero, to fractional_increment_shares
long_rounding.source: prereg section 4 step 4: 'a non-negative target is rounded half away from zero'

short_rounding.source: prereg section 4 step 4: 'a negative target is rounded toward zero to whole shares (shorts are whole shares only ...)'

data_feed.rule: the operative feed is a runtime input (forward/daily_f2.py --feed): 'sip', or 'iex' if the first connection session finds SIP daily bars refused for the account, fixed before any ledger record; every record stores the feed it used and the book refuses a change after the first record; this file holds both feeds and is never edited for the fallback
data_feed.source: prereg section 6 first bullet ('forward/config_f2.json holds both feeds and is never edited for this; every ledger record stores the feed it used'); lead ruling Q18 2026-10-18
data_feed.note: bars requested with adjustment raw; total returns from raw closes and the corporate actions endpoint (prereg section 6); Alpaca's 'all' adjustment is not used

cash_symbol.source: prereg section 3: 'BIL (SPDR Bloomberg 1-3 Month T-Bill ETF) is the cash benchmark of section 5; it is read daily and never traded'

replacement.rule: if the cash symbol has no bar in after_sessions consecutive sessions that are not missing days, SGOV (iShares 0-3 Month Treasury Bond ETF) is the cash benchmark from that session on, flagged cash_benchmark:SGOV; SGOV is read daily from the first record (never traded, not in the warm-up) so that its recorded close exists at the switch
replacement.source: prereg section 6, delisting bullet (revised 11:50-11:55 PDT for reg_review.md S7)

denominator.source: lead ruling S8 B-R2; CS A3, A5 (C-DEF:112-119 'func: "sysquant.estimators.vol.mixed_vol_calc"')

recent_span.source: CS A5, A12 (C-DEF:116 'days: 35'; C-VOL:188 'ewm(adjust=True, span=days, min_periods=min_periods).std()')

business_days_per_year.source: CS A12c (C-DATE:26 'BUSINESS_DAYS_IN_YEAR = 256.0'); slow span = years x 256 (C-VOL:170)

dollar_vol_definition.value: multiplier x 16 x daily price-difference vol

estimate.value: Pearson correlation of the four scaled, capped forecasts, weekly (W-FRI last), pooled (stacked) over the 12 instruments' live dates 2010-07..2024-02, full span
estimate.source: lead_spec_B S3.3; weekly frequency from CS A9b (C-DEF:155 'frequency: "W"')

warmup_diffs.source: MicroBookCoder choice (microbook/README.md): an instrument is live once 256 daily differences exist (the slowest EWMAC span); not a Carver figure

buffer_size.source: lead ruling S8 B-R3; CS A13 (C-DEF:297 'buffer_size: 0.10'; P-NOV21 'a simple 10% of average position')

rounding.source: lead ruling S8 B-R3 (posts silent; pysystemtrade rounds half to even)

idm.source: prereg section 2: 'forward.core.idm_for_live on E22-F1's frozen 12 x 12 subsystem-return correlation (config_f1.json idm), restricted to the 11 exposures this universe models (MZL, soybean oil, excluded), over the live instruments, cap 2.5, negative correlations floored at zero: 2.3293791420997985 when all 11 are live'; the runner recomputes it over the live instruments each session; value = all 11 live

commission_usd.source: prereg section 5: 'commission 0'; fees_facts.md F1: 'Alpaca Securities does not charge commissions, except as described below'

half_spread_table.source: prereg section 5: 'per share, half the quoted spread h_i (forward/tables_f2.json)'

sec_fee_rate.applies_to: sells, including short sales; x trade value (shares x fill price)
sec_fee_rate.source: prereg section 5: 'the SEC transaction fee "$0.0000206 * Trade Value" on sells (including short sales)'; fees_facts.md F1 (Alpaca fee schedule revised October 12, 2026)

finra_taf_per_share.source: prereg section 5: 'the FINRA Trading Activity Fee at the schedule's printed "$0 per share"'; fees_facts.md F1

cat_fee_per_share.applies_to: every fill (buys and sells), per executed share
cat_fee_per_share.source: prereg section 5: 'the FINRA CAT fee "$0.000003 per executed equivalent share" on every fill'; fees_facts.md F1

fee_rounding.value: each regulatory fee type (SEC, TAF, CAT) summed over the session's fills and rounded up to the next 0.01 USD; half spreads are not rounded
fee_rounding.source: prereg section 5: 'each fee type summed over the session's fills and rounded up to the next $0.01'

borrow_fee_b.units: per year, on |short notional|, x d / 360
borrow_fee_b.source: prereg section 5: 'b = 1.0% a year ... a declared allowance for periods in which a commodity fund becomes hard to borrow' (fees_facts.md F5)

margin_spread_s.units: per year, on max(0, L - K), x d / 360
margin_spread_s.source: prereg section 5: 's = 2.50% a year: Alpaca's default margin rate 6.50% (fees_facts.md F4) minus the upper bound of the FOMC's federal funds target range, 4.00% since 2026-09-17'

day_count.source: prereg section 5: 'b x d / 360', 's x d / 360'

fills.value: orders from data through close(t) fill at close(t+1), the raw close of the next processed session's daily bar; an order expires if the ETF has no close that session

share_update_tolerance.rule: the section 5 share-update factor rawclose(t-1) x (1 + r(t)) / rawclose(t) is set to exactly 1 when |factor - 1| <= value, so float noise on a day with no split or distribution leaves the shares unchanged
share_update_tolerance.source: F2BookCoder implementation guard against floating-point noise, not in the prereg text; lead ruling requested (f2book_report.md Q1)

fee_cent_rounding_guard.rule: ceil(round(total_usd x 100, value)) / 100: float noise below 1e-6 cent is ignored
fee_cent_rounding_guard.source: F2BookCoder implementation guard against floating-point noise, not in the prereg text; lead ruling requested (f2book_report.md Q11)

late_corporate_actions.rule: a corporate action of these types whose ex_date falls in a session already recorded, published only after that record was written, is booked in the next record: a distribution as cash P&L (shares held into the ex_date session x k x the per-share amount, k the product of that session's split ratios, recorded and late), a split by multiplying those shares by its ratio; flagged late_ca; any other type of a held ETF is flagged and not booked; each action is keyed by symbol, type, ex_date and amount or ratio (two actions with the same symbol, type and ex_date but different amounts are two actions) and booked once
late_corporate_actions.source: prereg section 6 (corporate actions endpoint types 'cash_dividend including special dividends, capital_gains_distribution, forward_split, reverse_split'; late corporate action bullet) and section 5 (fifth P&L term); wave 3 (reg_review.md B2, S2)

prev_close_mismatch_rel.rule: r and the share update use the recorded previous close; when the source's own previous close (k_src x (rawclose(t) + D_src) / (1 + r_src), from the source's bar and the actions inside its r, checked when the source's previous session is the recorded one) differs from the recorded close by more than value relative, the record is flagged prev_close_mismatch:SYM
prev_close_mismatch_rel.source: prereg section 6, r_i(t) bullet (revised 11:50-11:55 PDT for reg_review.md B1)

suspect_split_move_ratio.rule: an instrument whose raw close moves with |ln(rawclose(t) / rawclose(prev))| > ln(value) and no split in (prev, t] is treated as having no bar on t, flagged suspect_split:SYM
suspect_split_move_ratio.source: prereg section 6, suspect split bullet (reg_review.md S6)

suspect_split_max_sessions.rule: after value suspect sessions without a split covering the move, the move is accepted as a price move (flagged suspect_split_accepted:SYM)
suspect_split_max_sessions.source: prereg section 6, suspect split bullet (reg_review.md S6)

delisting_sessions.rule: an instrument with no bar in value consecutive sessions that are not missing days is closed at its last recorded close as a fill with costs in the value-th such session's record (leg 'delist'), dropped for the rest of the test (weights and IDM over the remaining live instruments) and never re-entered; flagged delisted:SYM
